title: Iraqi Air Force Kills 3 ISIS Militants in Kirkuk Province Airstrikes
detail: The Iraqi Air Force conducted coordinated airstrikes on ISIS hideouts in northern Kirkuk Province on May 7, 2026, killing three militants according to Iraq's Joint Operations Command Security Media Cell. The strikes targeted cave and tunnel network positions in the province's mountainous terrain, which ISIS has used as redoubts for its post-caliphate insurgency. The operations reflected the continuation of Iraqi counterterrorism activity against the ISIS insurgency even as broader regional military attention was consumed by the US-Iran conflict. Kirkuk, a contested province on the KRG-federal boundary, has been one of ISIS's most active insurgency zones alongside Anbar, Diyala, and Salah al-Din provinces.

media.caption: Iraqi Air Force airstrikes kill 3 ISIS militants in Kirkuk Province — Joint Operations Command confirms targeted strikes on cave and tunnel positions

title: US Treasury Sanctions Iraq's Deputy Oil Minister and PMF Leaders for Iran Oil Diversion Scheme
detail: The US Treasury Department designated Iraq's Deputy Oil Minister Ali Maarij al-Bahadly and senior leaders of the Iran-aligned Kata'ib Sayyid al-Shuhada and Asa'ib Ahl al-Haq militias on May 7, 2026 for allegedly facilitating the diversion of Iraqi crude oil — worth several million dollars per day — by mixing it with Iranian oil for export in violation of US sanctions against Iran. All US-jurisdiction assets were frozen. The sanctions were part of a broader US pressure campaign that had targeted 7 PMF commanders from Kata'ib Hizballah, Harakat al-Nujaba, and Asa'ib Ahl al-Haq in an April 17 action. Iraq's government formally denied the allegations. The designations added complexity to PM-designate Zaidi's government formation as he attempted to balance maintaining US confidence while managing Iran-aligned coalition partners who depend on the PMF network.

media.caption: US Treasury sanctions Iraq's Deputy Oil Minister and PMF leaders for Iran oil-mixing sanctions evasion scheme — Baghdad denies allegations
